territories.name: Antigua and Barbuda
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Antigua and Barbuda levies its own value added tax, the Antigua and Barbuda Sales Tax (ABST), under the Antigua and Barbuda Sales Tax Act, 2006 (No. 5 of 2006), administered by the Inland Revenue Department, on taxable supplies by registered persons and on taxable imports, with a zero rate and a list of exempt supplies.
